segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin report the lotion gives a matte finish, does not feel oily during the day, and one notes it left a shine that took time to settle.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as non-greasy, absorbing well, and gentle/hydrating, though one felt it did not cover all the moisture needed in winter.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no breakouts, no stinging, and fragrance-free comfort, while others report a coconut-oil-triggered rash/dermatitis, irritation, or an ingredient list (alcohol) they flag as risky for sensitive skin.
segments.combination: One reviewer with oily combination skin reports a matte finish and no shine.
segments.mature: One reviewer credits the product's antioxidant content with helping prevent premature aging, implying use for mature-skin concerns.

concerns.aging: One reviewer mentions the Vitamin E/antioxidant content as helping prevent premature aging; no other aging-specific outcomes are reported.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers describe the lotion as hydrating or moisturizing, including for dry and winter-affected skin; one reviewer felt it did not fully cover her moisture needs in a dry winter climate.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive eyes/skin reports never getting red or irritated; another reports the product stings around the eyes specifically, though not on the face generally.
concerns.barrier: One acne-prone reviewer developed a rash-like dermatitis she attributes to coconut oil in the formula clogging pores and disrupting her skin; most other reviewers report no such reaction.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with dark spots uses it consistently as her SPF 50 choice but reports no specific effect on the spots themselves.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who mention breakouts report none ('doesn't make me break out'), but several describe new or worsening pimples, cystic-like irritation, or minor breakouts after starting the product, particularly among acne-prone or first-time users.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers describe the finish as non-oily or matte for oily/combination skin, though a few note the product feels greasy, shiny, or slow to absorb, especially under makeup.

extraits.titre: Not for acne prone skin! Comedogenic and causes irritation.
extraits.texte: I don't consider myself to have sensitive skin- acne prone, yes, but not sensitive. I can throw everything but the kitchen sink at my skin when it comes to exfoliating and my skin takes it beautifully. I used this product daily for about a month and started to see some irritation. Thought it was maybe the change in seasons or my other actives. I cut back on those products and the irritation got worse. Started to look like a rash / dermatitis thats caused by heavy moisturizers. Didnt even think thats it was the sunscreen until it was literally the only "new" product on my face. Went back to look at the product more closely. Contains coconut oil, which as an acne prone girly, I know this is very comedogenic / clogs pores / causes dermatitis. Sad because I liked everything else about the product- price, packaging, consistency, absorption, efficacy. Just doesn't work for my skin. 😞

Solid sunscreen for swimming, but I find it to be too heavy for daily wear. I have to be careful when trying new products because many can cause stinging and/or acne–I found that my skin was calm when using it, but I'm unsure if the sunscreen caused some minor breakouts, or if that was just my skin reacting to other factors.

I prefer chemical sunscreen. This Sun Bum Face Lotion sunscreen does not disappoint. It is lightweight and doesn't leave a whitecast. I also like that it has SPF 50. I have some dark spots on my face so I have been only using SPF 50 sunscreen for a while now. I put about two fingers worth of sunscreen on my face and it absorbs nicely on my skin and gives my skin a matte finish (which I also love because I have oily combination skin, and I don't want my face to look shiny like oily). I also like that it doesn't leave any stickiness.

Love this PF face otion! It is very hydrating, no pilling- can wear under foundation. I don't normally wear chemical sunscreens, but this is my new favorite! I have sensitive skin and love that this is fragrance-free.

"Sunscreen is soooo important for healthy skin and I've used a lot of different kinds over the years. This one is really good. The packaging is really nice, there's a pump to dispense it and a cap over the pump. It's really easy to get exactly the amount of product that you need. The sunscreen itself is on the liquidy side which is nice for distributing and absorbing into the skin. My skin is on the dry side, and for me it is non greasy and does not make my skin oily even throughout the day. I haven't tested this by being out in the sun a lot, but for every day use it's really nice."

Great product that feels like it's protecting my face well! Consistency is a little stickier than I might've liked - takes a little while to soak in in the mornings but then great coverage for the rest of the day! Use it daily, would say it brought about a small breakout when I first switched to using it, but after a couple of weeks my face is feeling great!

I'm always impressed with the sun bum brand. I found that this is a great daily sunscreen with a little bit of moisture. I'm experiencing a dry winter in the midwest so this definitely doesn't cover all of the moisture I currently need, but it's nice to have some hydration with the sunscreen.
